activities.name: Copy CSV to Table - metadata based

dependsOn.activity: Copy CSV to Table - metadata based

source.sqlReaderQuery: select MAX(LastModifytime) as NewWatermarkvalue from data_source_table;

sqlReaderQuery.value: select * from data_source_table where LastModifytime > '@{activity('Lookup - OldWaterMark').output.firstRow.WatermarkValue}' and LastModifytime <= '@{activity('Lookup - NewWaterMark').output.firstRow.NewWatermarkvalue}'
